name: Normet Spraymec 8100 VC
summary: Diesel or electro-hydraulic, self-propelled wet-mix shotcrete sprayer for medium and large tunnel cross sections. The spray boom is worked by wireless remote control and comes with SmartSpray Lite spraying automation; SmartSpray Pro/ProPlus and SmartScan thickness scanning are options.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Finnish maker Normet through its local offices. Normet's contact page lists European offices in Austria, Finland, France, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, but none in Germany. No German dealer, rental offer or price found.

sellers.name: Normet Group
sellers.note: Contact form and local office finder; nearest listed offices to Germany are Austria and Switzerland.

specs.label: Concrete pump output
specs.conditions: theoretical maximum, NSP 40 double piston pump
specs.quote: Concrete pump output: Up to 30 m3/h

specs.label: On-board compressor
specs.conditions: electrically operated screw compressor, adjustable air flow
specs.quote: Electrically operated screw compressor with adjustable air flow rate (8 m3/min, 10 m3/min or 12 m3/min)

specs.label: Carrier engine
specs.quote: Spraymec 8100 VC is powered by either a Tier 3 engine or, alternatively, with the latest Stage V technology

specs.label: Spraying automation
specs.value: SmartSpray Lite standard; SmartSpray Pro/ProPlus optional
specs.quote: Equipped with our innovative SmartSpray Lite spraying automation system (also available with SmartSpray Pro/ProPlus for an increased level of automation)

specs.label: Remote control
specs.value: wireless remote with 2 or 4 joysticks plus bridging cable
specs.quote: Advanced wireless remote control system with 2/4 joysticks for all relevant process controls and an additional cable for bridging the radio link and the power supply

specs.label: Drive
specs.quote: the machine is equipped with four-wheel steering and 4WD

notes: Wheeled tunnelling carrier with one spray boom (manipulator) carrying the concrete nozzle.

SmartSpray Lite: the operator steers only the nozzle with one joystick and the system keeps the nozzle aligned to the surface; Pro adds point-to-point moves; ProPlus sprays a pre-defined area automatically (maker). The SmartSpray page names the Spraymec 8100 as one of the machines it is available for.
FOPS/ROPS cabin; SmartScan laser scanning for sprayed concrete thickness is optional. A battery-electric version is sold as Spraymec 8100 VC SD.
